newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends stronger vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends stronger vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished stronger at 43.7500/7520 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday helped by a temporaray shortfall in local currency liquidity, dealers said.
The taka closed at 43.7600/7700 on Thursday.

The call money was traded at nine to 11 percent from between six and 6.5 percent previously. Dealers said call rates shot up following Wednesday's auction of central bank bills worth about 3.3 billion taka.
